title: Inside the Massive LA Bookstore Filled With Hidden Vaults
description:
Discover The Last Bookstore, a world-famous cultural hub and unique refuge in Downtown Los Angeles. This iconic space is one of the most popular Los Angeles public resources for arts, culture, and community. Learn how founder Josh Spencer overcame a life-changing injury to build a creative oasis from his deep love of stories.

Local artists and family helped design this magical shop inside an old bank building. Explore the massive book tunnel, hidden vaults, and a huge record shop. It is a true melting pot that attracts world leaders, famous celebrities, and book lovers from everywhere. See how one creative vision changed the history of downtown LA forever.
